spans.s: अापत्ति (1) production; resulting of something into another; change; cf दन्त्यस्य मूर्धन्यापत्तिः नतिः मूर्धन्यापत्तिः मूर्ध- न्यभावः V. Prāt.
and Uvaṭa's com. thereon; cf also यमापत्तिं explained as यमभावं R. Pr.
. (2) modification; cf. अापद्यते श्वासतां नादतां वा R.Pr.

अाप्य to be obtained by an activity: (the same as vyāpya). The term is used in connection with the object of a verb which is to be obtained by the verbal activity. The word अाप्य is found used in the sense of Karman or object in 8 the grammars of Jainendra, Śāka- ṭāyana, Cāndra and Hemacandra; cf. Cāndra II
. Hence, the term साप्य is used for a transitive root in these grammars.
